Method of Attack: Exploitation of zero-day vulnerability CVE-2023-0669 in Fortra GoAnywhere MFT (Managed File Transfer) to steal data and enable ransomware attacks
Impacted Systems: Hitachi Energy systems using GoAnywhere MFT
Attack Vector: Zero-day vulnerability exploitation in GoAnywhere MFT software
Indicators of Compromise: Clop ransomware gang extortion portal listing Hitachi Energy
Clop ransomware group breach announcements starting February 10, 2023
